ELI5: What is Shadow Banned... I see a lot of users saying their "Other Place" account got Shadow Banned. Is it a banning, that the use doesnt know about?
That is exactly what shadow banning is. But, it is easy to tell if you're shadow banned, so it doesn't really work too well.
There are services that can that tell you. The user may notice that none of their comments are getting upvoted/downvoted or responded to as well.
interesting. Does the content a shadow banned user posts, get visibility to the rest of the site?
Nope, nobody sees it except the user.
Also, visiting your profile in incognito mode and it being non-existent is another sign.

Shadow banning is when a user is banned, but they don't know that they are banned. Meaning, they can comment, upvote, and do everything that a user can, and it will show on their profile, but no one else can see it. It was originally intended for bots that would spam messages so that they could not auto-detect that they had been blocked, but it was also applied to human users. It's easy for a person to check because all they have to do is try to go to their user page from an incognito window, and if it says that it's deleted but they can still log on, they're blocked.
Great explaination. I'd upvoat you if I could!

Ban: you can't use your account anymore, everything you've done is deleted

Shadowban: You can still use your account (even posting and stuff), but everything you do will be hidden from other users, unless it's approved by a mod. Also, your user page is a 404 (see)
